chapters.title: 从今天返回旧址
chapters.caption: 城市的过去没有消失，它仍藏在道路、建筑与人的记忆里。
chapters.caption_en: The city's past remains in its streets, buildings and memories.

chapters.title: 一条路经历三个名字
chapters.caption: 1901年至1915年，这里从西江路、宝昌路走向霞飞路。
chapters.caption_en: From 1901 to 1915, West River Road became Route Paul Brunat and then Avenue Joffre.

chapters.title: 原图落回城市
chapters.caption: 这幅原图尚有配准误差；它帮助辨认街道结构，但不制造精确门牌。
chapters.caption_en: This scan carries registration error: useful for street structure, not a precise doorstep.

chapters.title: 霞飞路436号亮起一盏灯
chapters.caption: 1934年，康健书局在霞飞路436号创办；这条事实可以回到上海图书馆事件数据复核。
chapters.caption_en: In 1934, Kangjian Bookstore opened at 436 Avenue Joffre, supported by the library event record.

chapters.title: 同一条路继续改名
chapters.caption: 霞飞路随后成为泰山路、林森中路，并在1950年定名淮海中路。
chapters.caption_en: Avenue Joffre became Taishan Road, Linsen Middle Road, then Huaihai Middle Road in 1950.

chapters.title: 把记忆带回今天
chapters.caption: 现代三维城市只负责定位；历史结论仍然由来源、时间和不确定性共同限定。
chapters.caption_en: The modern 3D city locates the place; sources and uncertainty still bound every historical claim.
